query:
SELECT 
  t.id, t.amount, t.reason, t.description, t.balanceAfter, t.createdAt,
  u.tokenBalance as currentBalance
FROM token_transactions t
JOIN app_users u ON u.id = t.appUserId
WHERE u.email LIKE '%8822705%'
ORDER BY t.createdAt ASC;
